title: BioIVT: anatomic location questions become a type-ahead SNOMED CT body structure lookup
description: Turns the free-text Anatomic Location question on Oncology, the BioIVT oncology form, Follow-up and Outcome into a type-ahead lookup over real SNOMED CT body structure codes at organ and region level (about 480 terms), plus Blood, Cerebrospinal fluid, Urine and Saliva, which Detroit sites also enter as a location. DEMONSTRATION list: real codes, partial, not clinically reviewed; licences to be confirmed before real use.
rationale: Dan's decision: SNOMED CT for anatomic location. Real answers are organ level (Lung, Breast, Colon, Blood, Uterus, Stomach).
source: BioIVT Option C build for the client demonstration; approved by Dan

history.note: Phase 2 build for the client demonstration.
